name: Pete Hegseth
role: US Secretary of Defense / War (2025-), former Fox News host and Army National Guard officer
summary: Hegseth is a strongly conservative, Christian-identified Trump ally who opposes globalism, DEI and what he calls woke politics. He favors a more lethal military with fewer legal constraints, tariffs, a border wall, strong support for Israel and a restructured NATO. Several of his positions are drawn from secondary summaries of his books and speeches.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Backed premium support for Medicare and privatizing Social Security in 2012; no support for state-guaranteed care found.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Opposes socialism and favored privatizing Social Security; no direct statement on markets versus government.

cut-welfare.rationale: Supported cutting Medicare and Medicaid and reducing benefits for higher earners as part of entitlement reform; the dependency framing itself is not documented.

limit-guns.rationale: Defends gun rights and urges carrying firearms where businesses ban them.

empower-police-military.rationale: Seeks greater lethality and authority for the military and rolled back restrictive rules of engagement.

traditional-family.rationale: 2012 pledge to uphold traditional marriage; opposed contraception mandates.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: 2012 campaign pledge to uphold traditional marriage; 2002 editorials he backed opposed gay marriage. No more recent clear statement; he later disputed claims he opposed repeal of Don't Ask, Don't Tell.

abortion-legal.rationale: Opposes abortion; 2012 pledge to defend the rights of the unborn.

more-religion-public.rationale: Calls for a Christian-framed "holy war" for freedom, criticizes secular schools lacking the Bible, and promotes evangelical Christianity in the Pentagon, including prayer in his speech.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Ended military DEI programs and opposed renaming Army bases named for Confederates.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Opposes transgender service and banned gender pronouns and identity months in the military; no direct statement on the theory.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Champions Western and Judeo-Christian civilization ("thank a crusader").

reduce-immigration.rationale: Supports a border wall and limiting Muslim immigration; says the government should gain operational control of the border.

free-trade.rationale: Urged tariffs and opposed globalism in American Crusade.

nation-first.rationale: Defines Americanism as opposition to globalism; criticizes NATO and the UN.

open-borders.rationale: Opposes open borders and supports a border wall.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Called climate policy a left-wing conspiracy for government control (2019); as secretary cancelled Pentagon climate studies (2025).

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: American Crusade urges raising tariffs as part of fighting globalism.

democracy-best.rationale: In American Crusade wrote that calls for democracy reject the American system and backed partisan gerrymandering; favors a constitutional republic.

separate-church-state.rationale: Derided "secular humanism" and promotes Christianity in the military; no statement on formal church-state separation.

military-superiority.rationale: Warns China is building a military to defeat the US and stresses lethality and winning as secretary.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Called Israel God's chosen people, opposed a two-state solution and as secretary calls Israel a model ally.

force-without-un.rationale: Supported killing Soleimani and strikes on Iran without regard to UN approval, and told readers the Geneva Conventions disadvantage the US.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Most recent position: at his January 2025 hearing he accepted women in combat provided standards stay high, and as Secretary he set the same combat-arms standards for men and women (Sept 2025). He had said in 2024 that women should not serve in combat roles, and earlier allegedly that they should not vote or work (denied). Reading of fit to this statement is indirect, hence medium.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: American Crusade says Americans should learn English; no explicit statement on giving up original culture.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: American Crusade urges readers to distrust and despise almost all politicians.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Criticized prosecution of soldiers for war crimes, supported pardons for Lorance and Gallagher, and called the Iron Triangle prosecutions atrocities.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Wants NATO restructured with Europe paying for its own defense, not ended.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Urges distrust of credentialed experts and calls universities and schools indoctrination camps.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: Praises Western civilization and the Crusades and calls Islam not a religion of peace.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Opposed a two-state solution and supported Israeli sovereignty over the West Bank.

collective-defense.rationale: Called NATO "not an alliance" to be scrapped and remade; as secretary he affirmed commitments to partners such as Israel.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Wants DEI ended in the military, called "diversity is our strength" the dumbest phrase, and ended such programs as secretary; says promotions were driven by race and gender quotas.

notes: Women in combat: said in 2024 they should not serve, then at his 2025 hearing said standards matter more (s5); answered under distinct-gender-roles using the later hearing and Secretary-era position (recency rule). Marriage and abortion positions date from 2012 and 2002. Much of the book content comes via Wikipedia summaries, not the book itself. war.gov transcripts returned HTTP 403, so no official primary page could be opened; s4 (CNN transcript of his speech) remains the only primary source.
